[NADP.3.2] **Lifecycle picking (LADP / LFAC).** Every
schema declares LOGICAL or TTL. The adapter picks per
emitted fact type:

| Fact kind                                  | Lifecycle |
|---|---|
| Entity state (device state, retained topics) | LOGICAL — retract-and-replace on meaningful change |
| Entity events (transient events, non-retained messages) | TTL — one event one fact, expires after the schema's ttl_ns |
| Service-call responses (the response fact / CallError) | TTL — the response schema must be, see [LCRS.4.3.2] |
